title: Quest live differential Cartesian tracking with pre-solve workspace projection
method_record: docs/teleop/Cơ sở lý thuyết và thuật toán Teleoperation từ Meta Quest 3 sang cánh tay Unitree R1.md
comparability: Not directly comparable with schema-3 iterative pose-IK runs: this profile uses one differential DLS step per command and projects definitely unreachable wrist positions before computing the Jacobian.

controller.jax_policy: JAX vmap is permitted only after a compatible JAX build is present and verified inside unitree_sim_env. The current Isaac Sim 5.1 environment has no JAX, so this run uses the already validated NumPy backend without changing environment dependencies.

workspace_projection.limitation: The outer reach sphere rejects points that are definitely unreachable; points inside may still be constrained by the complete joint limits.

calibration.position_policy: The first enabled Quest sample is latched to the measured robot pose; subsequent wrist displacement is scaled by 0.75. Exact-timing Isaac replay selected this over 0.65, 0.80, and 0.85: 0.80/0.85 entered a left-arm joint-limited branch while 0.65 retained excessive elbow flexion.
calibration.validation_status: Passed exact recorded-data Isaac replay on 2026-08-21 for simulation evidence; requires the operator's planned new live Quest run before any hardware claim.
calibration.orientation_policy: Wrist and head rotations are applied relative to the first enabled sample, avoiding an absolute orientation jump when the deadman is pressed.

whole_upper_body.body_mode_note: The make teleop-arms target overrides this to arms_head and records the effective 12-joint order.

invalid_if: the effective controller is not differential_dls
the effective body mode or controlled joint ordering is missing
raw and projected targets are not both recorded
